note: Premise accepted, prescription declined. The reviewer's prescription -- represent and extract a protocol result as a concrete instance pointer -- was declined with measured evidence: running the reviewer's own cited program end to end exits 101 at crates/pycc_mir/src/expr.rs:876 ("method 'foo' not declared on class 'P' or any base in its MRO -- pycc_types::check should have rejected this HIR before it reached pycc_mir"), so the arm is unreached because MIR lowering panics first, not because codegen represents the type wrongly; git diff --stat 71ad0bd6 HEAD -- crates shows pycc_mir untouched, so that panic is pre-existing. Fixed by narrowing the comment to state the true reason per variant and citing the real defect, filed as #934. Same class as rounds 1-2 (an artefact asserting a support contract the code contradicts), and the third instance in this diff: the identical claim was also corrected in docs/sessions/2026-09-05-01-issue-925-container-returns.md and in the pull-request body, which is direct evidence for umbrella #806 checklist item 2.
